sumInsured: Not specified (as per Policy Schedule / Schedule of Coverage)

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote:
6. Sum Insured Rebound
We will add to the Sum Insured, an amount equivalent to the Claim amount paid under Basic Sum Insured,subject to maximum of Basic Sum Insured on subsequent Hospitalization of the Insured Person during Policy Year
great.reference: Section B > III Optional Covers > 6. Sum Insured Rebound (page 15)
great.explanation: The policy adds extra Sum Insured equal to the claim amount paid under the basic Sum Insured for subsequent hospitalizations within the same policy year, up to 100% of the basic Sum Insured. This gives you additional coverage if you have multiple hospitalizations in one year.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay for the Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred during the 60 days immediately before Hospitalization of an Insured Person
good.reference: Section B > I Hospitalization Cover > 4. Pre-hospitalization cover (page 10)
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered. This helps cover costs related to diagnosis and treatment leading to your hospital stay.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay for the Post-HospitalizationMedical Expenses incurred upto180 days from the date Insured Person is discharged from Hospital
good.reference: Section B > I Hospitalization Cover > 5. Post-Hospitalization cover (page 10)
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after hospital discharge are covered. This supports recovery by covering follow-up treatments and medications.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 48 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.reference: Section C > 1.I Waiting Periods > i) Pre-existing Diseases – Code – Excl01 (page 19)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 48 months of continuous coverage with the insurer. This is a standard waiting period before claims for such conditions are accepted.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatmentsshall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with us.
good.reference: Section C > 1.I Waiting Periods > ii) Specified Disease/Procedure waiting period – Code – Excl02 (page 19)
good.explanation: Treatment for specified diseases or procedures is covered after 24 months of continuous coverage. This waiting period applies to certain listed illnesses and surgeries.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: Restore benefit not found in the provided policy wording extract.
bad.reference: Not found in provided document text
bad.explanation: Sum Insured is not replenished after a claim unless you opt for additional covers like Sum Insured Rebound. This means your coverage reduces after a claim and is not automatically restored.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Consumables benefit / consumables cover not found as a separate explicit coverage (only listed under medical expenses generally).
bad.reference: Not found as a specific consumables cover in provided text
bad.explanation: Consumables such as gloves, syringes, and PPE kits are not explicitly covered and may need to be paid out-of-pocket. Lack of explicit coverage means these costs could be excluded.

bad.name: NCB
bad.quote: Cumulative Bonuswill be reduced at the same rate as accrued in the event of admissible Claim under Section B-I of the Policy.
bad.reference: Section B > II Renewal Benefits > 2. Cumulative Bonus (page 11)
bad.explanation: The no-claim bonus reduces when you make a claim, lowering your future discounts. This means you lose part of your renewal benefit after a claim.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Insured Person shall bear specified percentage of admissible Claim amount under each and every Claim If Co-payment is applicable
bad.reference: Section B > I Hospitalization Cover (repeated across benefits, pages 10-11)
bad.explanation: The co-payment percentage is not explicitly stated for the base plan in the policy wording. Verify from the Policy Schedule whether co-pay applies and at what rate.

unclear.name: Room Rent
unclear.quote: Room rent, boarding and Nursing charges
unclear.reference: Section B > I Hospitalization Cover > 1. Medical Expenses (page 10)
unclear.explanation: The policy wording does not clearly state the default room rent limit or capping. You need to check the Policy Schedule to know if there is a cap or if room rent is covered at actuals.

unclear.name: Initial Waiting Period
unclear.quote:
30-day waiting period – Code – Excl03
Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident... This exclusion shall not, however, apply if the Insured Person has continuous coverage for more than twelve months.
unclear.reference: Section C > 1.I Waiting Periods > iii) 30-day waiting period – Code – Excl03 (page 20)
unclear.explanation: There is a 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses except accidents, but it may be waived if you have continuous coverage over 12 months. Clarify how this applies on renewals or port-ins.
